transcript.text: Hello everyone and welcome back. Today we are talking about Steve Jobs,
the legendary co-founder of Apple who revolutionized the personal computer industry,
music with the iPod, phones with the iPhone, and digital animation with Pixar.

to returning and creating the most valuable company in the world.

result.full_text: Hello everyone and welcome back. Today we are talking about Steve Jobs, the legendary co-founder of Apple who revolutionized the personal computer industry, music with the iPod, phones with the iPhone, and digital animation with Pixar. His life was full of incredible ups and downs, from being fired from Apple to returning and creating the most valuable company in the world. But one of the key elements of Steve's success was the guidance he received from his close friends and mentors throughout his career. In particular, Steve often talked about his mentor Andy Grove, the former CEO of Intel, who helped him navigate the complex business challenges during the 1990s.
